name: Auto Hand-off
description: Automatic account switching for Orca agents. Pools the managed accounts per provider (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Devin): on a rate limit or usage threshold it hands the pane off to the next account of that provider and resumes the session, so the model and the context never change. To reach panes outside the focused workspace it also runs the orca CLI (account select, terminal close/send).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Claude accounts
settings.description: Off: Claude panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Codex accounts
settings.description: Off: Codex panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Antigravity accounts
settings.description: Off: Antigravity panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off OpenCode accounts
settings.description: Off: OpenCode panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Auto hand-off Devin accounts
settings.description: Off: Devin panes are never switched or resumed automatically (manual switching still works).

settings.title: Strategy
settings.description: drain: stay on an account until it is limited, then take the next in chain order. balanced: the account with the most room. priority: always the first healthy account in the chain. soonest-reset: the account whose weekly window resets first, so expiring usage is spent first. manual: never switch automatically.

settings.title: Switch back when a higher-priority account resets
settings.description: drain and priority only: once an account earlier in the chain is healthy again, new launches use it and sessions on lower accounts move back when they finish a turn (or sit idle, see below).

settings.title: Minimum minutes between automatic selection changes
settings.description: Applies to threshold, switch-back and idle moves, so two accounts near the line never ping-pong. Rate limits and auth failures ignore it.

settings.title: Minimum headroom gap for a threshold move (%)
settings.description: A threshold move needs a target with at least this many points more room than the current account (when both are known). An exhausted account may always leave.

settings.title: Move idle sessions after (seconds)
settings.description: A session idle this long on an over-threshold account, or on a lower account while a higher-priority one is healthy, is moved. 0 = off. Sessions with unsent text in the input box are left alone.

settings.title: Never switch to
settings.description: Comma-separated accounts that automatic hand-off never picks (emails, seat keys, or provider:*). Picking them from the panel still works.

settings.title: Switch at usage threshold
settings.description: Checked when an agent finishes a turn.

settings.title: 5-hour threshold (%)
settings.description: 100 = only when exhausted.

settings.title: Resume the session after a switch
First message after a switch
settings.description: Empty = resume silently.

settings.title: Wait for reset when every account is exhausted
Retry on API errors
settings.description: Types the first message again after a Fibonacci backoff (5 s … 120 s).

settings.title: Account chain
settings.description: Comma-separated order of accounts within each service: emails, seat keys (claude:<id>, codex:system) or provider:*. Example: me@example.com, claude:*. Empty = Orca's order. Switching never leaves the agent's own service.

settings.title: Model fallback
settings.description: Models to try in place before switching account when a model-specific cap is hit, e.g. claude=sonnet,haiku; codex=gpt-5-mini

settings.title: Default cooldown (minutes)
settings.description: Used when neither the message nor Orca says when a limit resets.

settings.title: Read usage from Orca every (seconds)
settings.description: How often the plugin reads Orca's usage numbers (15–3600). Orca itself refreshes the account in use about every 5 minutes while its window is open, and accounts not in use only when its usage view opens or right after an account switch, so a shorter period only picks those up sooner.

settings.title: Remember usage of accounts not in use for (hours)
settings.description: When Orca has no current numbers for an account, the plugin uses its last reading, shown with its age; windows whose reset time has passed count as reset. 0 = only Orca's current numbers.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Empty = detect (ORCA_CLI_COMMAND, the app bundle, then orca).

settings.title: Console status line header
settings.description: Optional line above the account rows of the console status line; empty = rows only. Placeholders: {model}, {ctxbar} context-left gauge, {ctx} context left %, {5h} and {7d} this pane's % left, {reset} time until the 5-hour window resets, {best} the best-model window's name. Example: {model} │ ctx {ctxbar} │ 5h reset {reset} │ best={best}

settings.title: Console status line bar width
settings.description: Cells per gauge. 8 keeps a row with three gauges and a cooldown inside 80 columns.
